Hi all,

Quick technical clarifications and what we'll run on 10/20: 

- Test harness: custom Gatling/Go harness that hits Redwood API with the same request shapes Beacon supplied. We will simulate retries with a configurable backoff; recommend Redwood simulate Beacon-retries unless Beacon wants to mirror production.
- Cache behavior: we will run three phases — cold start (no KV cache), warm-up (30 minute sustained to populate cache), steady-state (60-minute sustained at target concurrency). TTFT and first-token latency will be recorded for each phase.
- Burst profile: 2x, 5x, and 10x of steady ingestion for 3-minute bursts; observe queue lengths and drop rates.
- Rate-limit enforcement prototype: token-bucket with queue depth=200 requests; soft-reject fallback to a cheaper model variant when queue depth > 150. We will capture quality deltas for that fallback.
- Metrics: per-request TTFT, per-token latency percentiles (50/95/99), error/retry counts, queue depth over time, and CPU/GPU utilization traces.

Acceptance thresholds (we propose):
- Steady-state: 95th token latency <= 300 ms at 200 concurrent sessions.
- Burst: degradations allowed but system must not exceed 10% error rate and must maintain median TTFT <= 2.5x baseline.

I'll attach the raw harness config after preflight.
